summary: Describes a deployed extension to RADIUS that lets a server change a user session after it has begun, including disconnecting a user and changing the authorizations that apply. It documents what network access server products already did. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 5176.

eli5.summary: Normally a login server only answers when asked. This memo lets it tell a network box, while someone is online, to cut them off or change what they can do.
